summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for Hub.html, Order.html, Vendor.html, and Admin.html covering:
- Decoupled Vault release architecture and idempotent financial confirmation in Order.html
- Vendor Vault delivery setup, multi-type deliverable inputs, document uploading, appeals & WhatsApp redirection in Vendor.html
- Cross-page Global Product Search system with URL query parameters in Hub.html
- Dispute arbitration, reports queue, and payout execution in Admin.html
